title: HA-DRL Experimental Data
description: Processed experimental data accompanying Online UAV Path Planning for Persistent IoT Data Collection via Attention-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning, by Duocheng Xu, Wenmao Zhou, and MingWei Qin. The deposit contains 13 CSV tables with 3,837 records, including seed-level experimental summaries and reward coefficients, together with data-field definitions, units, experimental conditions, and file checksums.
